questions.question: Large crowds traveled from many places to find Jesus by the sea. What made them come?

answers.text: They heard what great things He was doing
They heard what new laws He was giving
They heard what signs the prophets foretold

questions.question: When unclean spirits saw Jesus, they fell down before Him and cried out. What did they say?

answers.text: You are the Son of God

questions.question: When Jesus went up on the mountain to appoint His twelve apostles, who did He call to come to Him?
Judas Iscariot, one of Jesus' twelve apostles, was the one who betrayed Him. True or false?
